qualification_credit: none; not a Forge screen, default promotion or Supra quality qualification
question: Does the learned conditional native game reproduce the particle adapter convergence gap on a target both adapter families can exactly represent?

host.routing: sequential sites, shared bank/controller, second site recomputed from first-site output
host.critic: 16->48->16 tanh features; pooled context score; explicit 769-dimensional source/time condition

prior.exception_reason: The subject is the shared routed ParticleGAN bank used by Supra, not a learned-MoG host.

initialization.networks: public particlegan.init.initialize_, sample_distributions_v1, distinct CPU generators bound to semantic parameter names
initialization.shared: bitwise identical ordinary/particle down/up and critic initial tensors; up factors zeroed after API initialization
initialization.teacher: ordinary rank-2 teacher; same declared down bases as the students, so the ordinary initial basis spans the teacher; separately initialized up rows normalized to fixed L2 norm 0.5 at both sites
initialization.reachability_gate: Install teacher down/up into both families and zero particle H/C/b; require identical complete outputs on fit, guard and test panels before training.
initialization.supra_difference: This named sampled network initialization is explicit and differs from the earlier Supra deterministic-orthogonal network cohort.

data.latent_geometry: first 2 of 16 token activations weighted sqrt(7), remaining 14 weighted 1, then normalized to overall RMS 0.77; fixed input heterogeneity, never an error-selected training weight
data.condition: fixed 768-dimensional source embeddings with RMS approximately 0.052, plus time; frozen projection into host activations
data.schedule: editing only; same fixed context order across arms
data.critic_coordinate_scale: fit teacher-minus-base standard deviation per coordinate, clamped at 0.04 and fixed thereafter
data.rng: isolated named initialization, fit-index, paired-base, DV12, birth/death and private evaluation streams; no seed scan

arms.optimizer: native generator AMSGrad beta=(0,0.999), paired RpGAN and KA2 critic, native stationarity/noise policy
arms.scaffold: public UpdatePolicy with frozen unoptimized R2 table; no router/table optimizer groups; both row controls disabled
arms.comparison_limit: Native owner-dependent support-floor and noise eligibility can differ from the full particle arm. This is a configuration comparison, not a pure architecture ablation.

arms.optimizer: full public e22_routed, AMSGrad beta=(0,0.999), paired RpGAN and KA2 critic
arms.row_controls: enabled; full-model candidate reruns; per-site DV12 and usage attribution
arms.guard: zero per-context learned-critic-feature harm on FAST and EMA; output guards disabled

arms.optimizer: historical AdamW, lr=5e-5, weight_decay=0.01, default betas, global gradient clip=1.0
arms.objective: paired output MSE, reference arm only
arms.comparison_limit: Separate historical objective/optimizer reference; never a particle optimizer, structural criterion or selection rule.

execution.timeout_verdict: incomplete, never convergence failure or success
execution.stopping: fixed external horizon or operational budget only; no metric-selected checkpoints, seeds, horizons or early stopping

evaluation.primary: clean FAST outputs on fixed paired panels, scored under EVERY mandatory common learned critic

private_game_panel.ownership: private evaluation generators; same draws across arms and judges

evaluation.checkpoint_law: complete native policy state plus fit-index and paired-base streams, host/task/config bindings; MSE reference owns model/AdamW/data streams separately; all fixed checkpoints every 200 updates
evaluation.selection: none; all four judges and all fixed checkpoints reported
evaluation.judge_checks: Report zero-residual teacher anchor (native RpGAN log(2)) and fresh initial generator under every mandatory common critic; a weak or reversed judge is reported without selection or substitution.

judge_reference_path.law: fixed interpolation of fresh teacher-relative residual toward zero; diagnostic reference path only, not a native optimizer or checkpoint selection

evaluation.secondary: policy-selected weights and native DV12 serving are separate named cohorts if measured
evaluation.gap_gate: A particle-versus-ordinary learned-game gap is reproduced only if BOTH native endpoint common critics rank ordinary ahead by more than 1e-4 in mean test-panel generator game loss at the fixed 6400 endpoint; do not infer it from own evolving losses or RMSE.
evaluation.causality: A learning gap alone is not a causal diagnosis; any new intervention needs a frozen substantive mechanism and a separate bounded declaration.

software_gates: nonzero retained-particle gradients after neutral warm start
named evaluation RNG does not advance training streams
storage: Local run.log, trace JSONL and checkpoints outside Git; tracked reproduction sources, compact results/provenance and explanation only.
